newsitem.title: USA: NY precious metals called to open mixed.
newsitem.headline: NY precious metals called to open mixed.

text.p: New York precious metals futures were called to open mixed though both silver and gold were due to begin trading unchanged.
COMEX December gold was called flat after last trading on ACCESS at $384.70 an ounce, up $0.10 from Friday's close. The ACCESS range was $384.70 to $384.40.
In New York bullion trade, spot gold was quoted early at $382.80/$383.20 versus the London morning fix of $382.80.
COMEX December silver was called flat.
On ACCESS, COMEX December silver last traded at $4.93, up 0.5 cent from Friday's close.
In London, silver was fixed at $4.9185, barely above Friday's $4.9025.
COMEX gold warehouse stocks were unchanged Friday at 1,053,619 ounces.
COMEX silver stocks, excluding Wilmington Trust silver stocks, rose 606,113 ounces Friday to 131,375,764 ounces.
NYMEX January platinum was called to open $0.50 to $1.00 firmer, while NYMEX December palladium was expected unchanged to $0.50 weaker.
